translations.name: Missouri Unclaimed Property (State Treasurer)
translations.description: About 1 in 10 Missourians has unclaimed money or property. The average return is about $300. Searching is free, and there is no deadline. Anyone can search, but only the owner or a legal heir can claim the property. Type in your name to see if the state is holding money for you.
translations.website_description: Missouri State Treasurer's free search and claim site for unclaimed money and property
